ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver. The distance finding rests on the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02827), which POL-RD-01 makes the governing field: 14.4 km driven against the booked optimal route of 9.0 km (EV-TRIP-02827), an excess of 5.4 km, or 60.0% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (above 0.8 km absolute and above 20%), so the deviation is established, and 60.0% also makes it a MATERIAL deviation (above the 50% material threshold). The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 114 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, so none of POL-RD-07 limbs (a) to (c) fires, no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. Nothing excuses the excess. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02827) holds 0 messages, so no rider-requested detour can run under POL-RD-04 and no distance is excluded. No pickup or dropoff was amended (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null), so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and the booked 9.0 km optimal stays the baseline; the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's counterparty statement says only 'Road works.'; no traffic advisory covers this trip window (EV-ADVIS-02827-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and the driver cited no advisory, so under POL-RD-13 that assertion cannot be tested against an advisory, carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and neither reduces the excess nor supplies an amended optimal route. Because no cited artifact is missing, POL-RD-10(5) is not triggered and no escalation arises. Money. The fare model is METERED. Under POL-RD-02 the recomputed fare on the booked optimal route is ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 9.0 km = 6.75 + 0.28 x 13.0 min = 3.64) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP = 14.99. Charged total is 20.66 (EV-FARE-02827), so the POL-RD-02 refund is 20.66 - 14.99 = 5.67, rounded up to 5.70 - above the 0.50 de minimis floor and 27.4% of charged_total. The POL-RD-06 uplift changes the outcome. The driver's trailing-90-day record (EV-DPROF-02827) shows deviation_flags_90d = 3 with completed_trips_90d = 180, which meets the '3 or more' limb and establishes a repeat pattern (prior_deviation_flags = 5 is a lifetime counter and is context only under POL-GEN-01, as both advocates correctly said). Because this trip's deviation is both MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own evidence - the unimpaired trace - POL-RD-06(b) licenses FULL_REFUND of the charged total instead of the POL-RD-02 partial. As the clause requires, the two figures side by side: POL-RD-02 partial = 5.70; POL-RD-06(b) uplifted figure = 20.66. No ERP, toll or airport-surcharge pass-through line exists to be settled separately under POL-RD-09 (all are 0.00), so the whole charged total moves. The rider advocate's submission that limb (b) should not run because the excess rests on the trace is rejected: limb (b), unlike limb (a), does not require an artifact other than the gps_trace. Referral. Because the pattern is established, POL-RD-06(c) adds a referral to driver-conduct review; it is a referral and not an escalation, and it neither displaces nor delays the refund. Execution and appeals. The monetary effect (20.66) exceeds the POL-GEN-05 automatic-execution threshold (8.00), so the refund issues but is held for release by the human queue; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04. Confidence is 0.90: every artifact carrying a deciding fact (EV-GPS-02827, EV-TRIP-02827, EV-FARE-02827, EV-DPROF-02827) is at weight 1.0, above the 0.70 floor, so no POL-RD-10(1) escalation fires.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
